name: blogincf
description: A Notion-powered blog rendered entirely on Cloudflare Workers.

NOTION_TOKEN.description: Notion Integration token with read access to the blog database.

NOTION_DATA_SOURCE_ID.description: Required Data Source ID of the Notion database containing posts. The site cannot load content without it.

NOTION_CONFIG_DATA_SOURCE_ID.description: Optional Data Source ID of the site configuration database.

SITE_URL.description: Optional canonical public URL used by RSS and sitemap output.

scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:worker: pnpm run cloudflare:auth && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:worker
